snippet.title: Creepy Horrors: Blood Cult 2 - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description: Get a peek at tactical gameplay and more from Creepy Horrors: Blood Cult 2 in this teaser trailer for the upcoming spooky occult creature collector RPG featuring 3v3 tactical battles. Build your roster of Creepy Horrors in this creature collector RPG. Crawl through crypts collecting blood, guts, and gore, combining these grisly ingredients to summon Horrors and wield them in merciless 3v3 battles against rival cults. The Crypts are calling. Will you answer? Creepy Horrors: Blood Cult 2 will be available on PC (Steam). A demo is coming soon.
